paragraphs: Rabbi Chiyya bar Ze’ira: Bamidbar Rabbah 11:2. Rav Yitzchak bar Ze’ira: Shabbat 20b. Rabbi Menachma bar Ze’ira: Bereshit Rabbah 34:9. Rav Shmuel bar Ze’ira: Bamidbar Rabbah 3:8. Rav Shemayah bar Ze’ira: Eruvin 93a.

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Shabbat 20b fully writes Rav Yitzchak bar Ze’ira, supporting Rav for supplied ר׳. The Midrash Rabbah — TE Bamidbar Rabbah 3:8 fully writes Rabbi Shmuel bar Ze’ira, whereas Hyman fully writes Rav; that full supplied title is preserved. The five listed people are not merged.
